name: RefundReceipt
description: A RefundReceipt represents a refund issued to a customer for a product or service that was provided.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: DepositToAccountRef
fields.description: Account from which payment money is refunded. Account.AccountType must be Other Current Asset or Bank.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: Individual line items of a transaction. Valid Line types include: SalesItemLine, GroupLine, DescriptionOnlyLine, DiscountLine and SubTotalLine (read-only).

attributes.name: LineNum
attributes.description: Position of the line in the collection of transaction lines.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Free-form description of the line item.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the line item.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: The type of line detail (e.g. SalesItemLineDetail, SubTotalLineDetail).

attributes.name: SalesItemLineDetail
attributes.description: Line detail for a sales item line.

attributes.name: Qty
attributes.description: Number of items for the line.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxCode for the line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: TaxCode.Id of the referenced tax code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced tax code.

attributes.name: SubTotalLineDetail
attributes.description: Line detail for a subtotal line (read-only).

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object, used to lock an object for use by one app at a time. Required for update. Only the latest version is maintained by QuickBooks Online.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts on the transaction are expressed. Conditionally required: must be defined if multicurrency is enabled for the company.

fields.name: PaymentRefNum
fields.description: The reference number for the payment received (e.g. check # for a check). Conditionally required. Provide when DepositToAccountRef references a Bank account; required when PrintStatus is PrintComplete.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Method in which tax is applied. Not applicable to US companies; required for non-US companies.

fields.name: ProjectRef
fields.description: Reference to the Project ID associated with this transaction. Conditionally required.

fields.name: BillEmail
fields.description: Identifies the e-mail address where the invoice is sent. Conditionally required: required input if EmailStatus=NeedToSend.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this transaction occurred. Defaults to the current server date if not supplied. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: CustomField
fields.description: One of, up to three custom fields for the transaction.

attributes.name: DefinitionId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the CustomField definition.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: Data type of the custom field (e.g. StringType).

attributes.name: StringValue
attributes.description: The value of the custom field when Type is StringType.

fields.name: ClassRef
fields.description: Reference to the Class associated with the transaction. Available if class tracking per transaction is enabled.

fields.name: PrintStatus
fields.description: Printing status of the invoice.

fields.name: CheckPayment
fields.description: Information about a check payment for the transaction. Used when PaymentType is Check.

fields.name: TxnSource
fields.description: The originating source of the credit card transaction. Currently the only supported value is IntuitPayment.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the entity. Values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created in the source domain.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated in the source domain.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction. If not provided at create time, populated based on Preferences:CustomTxnNumber. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User entered, organization-private note about the transaction. Maps to the Memo field on the refund receipt form; not shown to the customer.

fields.name: CustomerMemo
fields.description: User-entered message to the customer; this message is visible to the end user on their transaction.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The memo text shown to the customer.

fields.name: CreditCardPayment
fields.description: Information about a credit card payment for the transaction. Used when PaymentType is CreditCard.

fields.name: CustomerRef
fields.description: Reference to a customer or job.

fields.name: TxnTaxDetail
fields.description: Information for taxes charged on the transaction as a whole.

attributes.name: TotalTax
attributes.description: Total tax calculated for the transaction, excluding any tax lines manually inserted into the transaction line list.

attributes.name: TxnTaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the transaction tax code.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: TaxCode.Id of the referenced tax code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced tax code.

fields.name: PaymentMethodRef
fields.description: Reference to a PaymentMethod associated with this transaction.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: PaymentMethod.Id of the referenced payment method.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: PaymentMethod.Name of the referenced payment method.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The number of home currency units it takes to equal one unit of currency specified by CurrencyRef. Applicable if multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: ShipAddr
fields.description: Identifies the address where the goods must be shipped.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the address object.

attributes.name: Lat
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the geocoded address.

attributes.name: Long
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geocoded address.

fields.name: DepartmentRef
fields.description: Reference to a Department object specifying the location of the transaction. Available if department tracking is enabled.

fields.name: PaymentType
fields.description: The payment type for the refund.

fields.name: BillAddr
fields.description: Bill-to address of the Invoice.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the address object.

attributes.name: Lat
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the geocoded address.

attributes.name: Long
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geocoded address.

fields.name: ApplyTaxAfterDiscount
fields.description: If false or null, calculate sales tax first then apply discount. If true, subtract discount first then calculate tax. Default false. US versions only.

fields.name: HomeBalance
fields.description: Convenience field containing the amount in Balance expressed in the home currency. Calculated by QuickBooks. Applicable if multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: A reference to the Recurring Transaction template the RefundReceipt was created from.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced recurring transaction.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced recurring transaction.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction, including all charges, allowances, and taxes. Calculated by QuickBooks; any supplied value is overwritten.

fields.name: TaxExemptionRef
fields.description: Reference to the TaxExemption ID associated with this object. Available for companies with automated sales tax enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: System-generated Id of the exemption type. For internal use only.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The Tax Exemption Id for the customer, typically issued by the state.

fields.name: Balance
fields.description: The balance reflecting any payments made against the transaction. Initially set to TotalAmt. Calculated by QuickBooks; any supplied value is overwritten.

fields.name: HomeTotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction in the home currency. Calculated by QuickBooks. Valid only when CurrencyRef is specified. Applicable if multicurrency is enabled.

update.PrivateNote: This is a new private note added via sparse update.

specialOperations.name: Get a refund receipt as PDF
specialOperations.description: Returns the specified RefundReceipt object as an Adobe PDF file formatted according to the company's custom form styles.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm) for the QuickBooks Online company.

pathParams.name: refundreceiptId
pathParams.description: The ID of the RefundReceipt to retrieve as a PDF.

specialOperations.note: Returns a binary application/pdf response rather than JSON.

specialOperations.name: Send a refund receipt
specialOperations.description: Emails the specified RefundReceipt; populates DeliveryInfo and updates BillEmail.Address when an explicit sendTo email is supplied.

queryParams.name: sendTo
queryParams.description: Explicit recipient email address. If omitted, the address in RefundReceipt.BillEmail.EmailAddress is used. When supplied, RefundReceipt.BillEmail.Address is updated to this value.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm) for the QuickBooks Online company.

pathParams.name: refundreceiptId
pathParams.description: The ID of the RefundReceipt to send.

specialOperations.note: Two variants: implicit (uses RefundReceipt.BillEmail.EmailAddress) vs explicit (?sendTo=<emailAddr> query param).
